Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Channel Class¶

class Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Channel(instrument, data_handler, channel)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Channel commands are used to control and query channel-specific settings.

__init__(instrument, data_handler, channel)[source]¶

Initalize the channel class.

Parameters:

  • instrument (pyvisa.Resource) – The instrument to control.

  • data_handler (DataHandler) – The data handler for processing data.

  • channel (int) – The channel number, either 1 or 2.

  • decoder (Decoder) – The Decoder object for the channel.

  • etable (ETable) – The ETable object for the channel.

get_bandwidth_limit(channel)[source]¶

Query the bandwidth limit parameter of the specified channel.

Parameters:

channel (int) – The channel number, either 1 or 2.

Returns:

The bandwidth limit, either “20M” or “OFF”.

Return type:

str

get_coupling_mode(channel)[source]¶

Query the coupling mode of the specified channel.

Parameters:

channel (int) – The channel to query (e.g., channel number or identifier).

Returns:

The coupling mode reported by the instrument (for example ‘DC’, ‘AC’, or ‘GND’).

Return type:

str

get_offset()[source]¶

Query the vertical offset of the specified channel. The default unit is V.

Returns:

The vertical offset value in volts.

Return type:

str

get_probe_ratio()[source]¶

Query the probe attenuation ratio for a channel.

Returns:

Probe attenuation ratio.

Return type:

str

get_range()[source]¶

Query the vertical range of the specified channel. The default unit is V.

Returns:

The vertical range value in volts.

Return type:

str

get_scale()[source]¶

Query vertical scale of the channel.

Returns:

Vertical scale value in volts per division.

Return type:

str

get_tcal()[source]¶

Query delay calibration time for the specified channel (in seconds).

Returns:

value in scientific notation as float.

Return type:

float

get_units()[source]¶

Query the amplitude display unit for a channel.

Returns:

Amplitude display unit.

Return type:

str

get_vernier()[source]¶

Query vernier setting.

Returns:

“ON” if vernier is enabled, “OFF” if disabled.

Return type:

str

invert_waveform(type)[source]¶

Set the invert mode of the specified channel.

Parameters:

type (str or int) – The invert mode to apply to the channel. Allowed values are “ON” or “OFF” (strings) or 1 or 2 (integers). The channel affected is taken from self.channel and must be 1 or 2.

is_inverted(channel)[source]¶

Query the invert mode of the specified channel.

Parameters:

channel (int) – The channel to query.

Returns:

The invert mode reported by the instrument for the given channel (e.g., ‘1’/’0’ or ‘ON’/’OFF’).

Return type:

str

set_bandwidth_limit(bw)[source]¶

Set bandwidth limit of the specified channel.

Parameters:

bw (str) – Bandwidth limit to set. Allowed values: “20M” or “OFF”.

set_coupling_mode(coupling_mode)[source]¶

Set the coupling mode of the instrument for the channel specified by self.channel.

Parameters:

coupling_mode (str) – The coupling mode to set for the current channel. Must be one of “AC”, “DC”, or “GND”.

set_offset(param1)[source]¶

Set the vertical offset of the specified channel (in volts).

Parameters:

param1 (float) – The offset value to set, in volts.

set_probe_ratio(ratio)[source]¶

Set the probe attenuation ratio for a channel.

Parameters:

ratio (float) – Probe attenuation ratio to set.

set_range(param1)[source]¶

Set the vertical range of the specified channel. The default unit is V.

Parameters:

param1 (float) – The vertical range value to set, in volts.

set_scale(scale)[source]¶

Set vertical scale of the channel (in V/div).

Parameters:

scale (float) – Vertical scale value to set, in volts per division.

set_tcal(val)[source]¶

Set delay calibration time for the specified channel.

Parameters:

val (float) – delay time in seconds (e.g., 20e-9 for 20ns). Valid range: -100e-9 to 100e-9.

set_units(unit)[source]¶

Set the amplitude display unit for a channel.

Parameters:

unit (str) – Options: VOLTage, WATT, AMPere, UNKNown.

set_vernier(state)[source]¶

Enable or disable fine adjustment (vernier) for vertical scale.

Parameters:

state (str) – “ON” to enable vernier, “OFF” to disable.
